# UnoDOS 3 (Source Solutions), test fixture

`unodos.rom` (8K divMMC firmware) and `card/dos/unodos.sys` (system file the firmware loads from the card) are the
binaries of https://github.com/source-solutions/unodos3 (GPLv3, see LICENSE-unodos3), `bin/` at the commit used by
`DivMmcUnoDos_Test`. The `card/` folder is presented as a FAT16 SD card by `HostFolderFat`.
